hint:
A request value joined into SQL text with + or an f-string reaches execute().
Only a parameterized call, execute(sql, params), stops this class.

vulnerable.code:
from flask import Flask, request
app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/users")
def users():
    name = request.args["name"]
    query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute(query)
    return "ok"

safe.code:
from flask import Flask, request
app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/users")
def users():
    name = request.args["name"]
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = %s", (name,))
    return "ok"
